summary.text: Scott Hill is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 24 (Dickinson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Scott Hill served in the House (2023–2025) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2025.
Scott Hill is listed as a member of the Education Committee, the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee and the Judiciary Committee.
The Legislature lists Scott Hill's occupation as Farmer.
The page names Lynette Hill as Scott Hill's spouse.
